reference_findings.diagnosis: Symptomatic coronary disease involving a bifurcation; lesion significance and strategy depend on anatomy, ischemia, side-branch importance and operator/Heart Team review.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: Intermediate-to-high anatomical complexity; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Sinus rhythm; no acute ischemic change.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: No acute hs-cTn rise/fall. CBC and renal function are supplied for procedural planning; no simulated critical abnormality.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: LVEF 58%; no resting regional wall-motion abnormality.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiography: 70% proximal LAD lesion involving a sizable first diagonal branch; side-branch ostial narrowing ~60%; LAD TIMI 3, diagonal TIMI 3. Lesion is described as a true bifurcation pattern in this synthetic case; exact classification requires expert image review.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 74 bpm; BP 132/80 mmHg; RR 16/min; SpO2 98%; stable.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Exertional angina with an abnormal stress imaging report.
history.history_of_present_illness: Stable exertional symptoms; no acute rest symptoms or dynamic ECG changes in this scenario.
medication_reconciliation: Fictional lipid-lowering medication; medication reconciliation pending

pathway_review.label: Review anatomy and consider intravascular imaging/physiology where indicated
pathway_review.reason: Complex lesion anatomy can benefit from additional characterization; modality selection needs clinical review.

pathway_review.label: Assume every bifurcation requires the same stent strategy
pathway_review.reason: Bifurcation anatomy and branch importance vary.

pathway_review.label: Reassess ischemia evidence and symptoms before elective intervention if uncertainty remains
pathway_review.reason: Stable presentation permits structured review when no high-risk features are present.

reference_findings.safety_review: Consent should include uncertainty, branch-related risks and alternatives; review renal function, allergy history, bleeding risk and medication interactions.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: expert planning node compares anatomy and physiology evidence. Simulation shows branch-flow status as an outcome metric, not step-by-step procedural instructions.
learning_objectives: Describe main-vessel and side-branch findings separately.
Avoid a universal bifurcation strategy assumption.
Use image quality and uncertainty explicitly.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
